extension_roadmap.validation: zero upload errors and platform-compliant size, frame rate and file weight
one semantic action stays readable across three character types without hiding identity anchors
alpha flicker, spill and interior-deletion rates remain below declared thresholds
known bad samples are blocked while human override and rationale remain auditable
old packs are reproducible and new packs trace back to role rules and approval versions
per-pack cost is predictable, sensitive inputs stay in policy and paid retries are auditable

known_boundaries: whole-sheet video can leak motion across cells
complex temporal matting is not included
local transform fallback is intentionally lightweight
platform-specific Telegram and Discord submission formats are not automated
remote provider quality, quota and billing require an explicitly authorized real call
